author: codex-ai-reviewer-s2
purpose: Independent AI visual second opinion on all eleven optical observations, for root consolidation of proposed labels with explicit scope and uncertainty. Not human ground truth or independent model validation.

ui_access.result: IAB unavailable in this subagent context; browser inventory empty
ui_access.fallback: Read-only SQLite and registered PNG/GeoTIFF assets; no other browser or user tab touched.

method: Read the three distinct registered 512 x 512 RGB previews and all twelve 256 x 256 quadrant enlargements.
Inspected all eleven zone overlays and automatic observable masks, plus detailed port and open-water crops.

Recorded visible objects and uncertain regions without using model proposal boxes as truth; a PRQ pilot preview with boxes was viewed once before identifying and switching to raw registered previews, so this pass is not fully blinded to proposal existence.
Queried exact proposal geometries after the raw-image pass to match the two clear isolated PRQ vessels.

Represented inspected scope as observable pixel cells intersected with zone and raster footprint; subtracted ambiguous regions from proposed training scope and both positive windows from proposed negative scope.
No family or physical dimensions inferred; no review action persisted.
coordinate_convention: Native preview pixels match the registered 512 x 512 RGB grid. Pixel boxes are [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax] at pixel edges, origin upper-left, half-open; GeoJSON coordinates are WGS84 longitude, latitude. Visual windows are approximate localization, never physical dimensions.
consolidation_notes: These labels are AI proposals. Record reviewer_kind=ai_visual_review and this report as provenance; never convert them to human-reviewed labels.
Scene completeness applies only to proposed_training_reviewed_area_wgs84, not the whole configured zone. Exclude all ambiguous, unobservable and out-of-crop regions.
Do not interpret model count zero as an empty port. All three dock scenes contain unresolved candidate structures/vessels.
PRQ canal and fondeo contain duplicate evidence of the eastern vessel. Deduplicate physical counts and keep observations from one acquisition in the same split.
PBR and STC share one Sentinel-2 acquisition; their crops must remain in the same split to avoid scene leakage.
Accept/reject recommendations concern presence only. Keep family, length_m and width_m null.
No precision, recall or historical change conclusion can be estimated from this same AI visual review.

ui_limitations_at_source_read.finding: Presence review offers accept/reject. The indeterminate button concerns family only, so it cannot record uncertainty about whether an object is a vessel.
The family-indeterminate action saves family:null; it is not a detection abstention or an unknown mask.

The complete-scene action sends scene_complete:true without user-drawn review scope or exclusion geometry. The current UI shows reviewed_area/provenance but the visible drawing tools select/add/move/redraw detections, not explicit unknown-region masks. Root is updating scope support; this observation is time-specific.
